entries.title: PR-1 + PR-2 are now on main — the full Loren upgrade is live behind the flag
bullets: Landed everything onto main: the animated Loren orb, the draggable tool carousels, conversation memory, the orchestrator, and live Property Search.
All icons are now on-brand line icons — zero emoji anywhere in the interface.
Nothing existing was touched — App.tsx was left exactly as main had it (the /loren mount was already there); every new file lives under src/loren/.
To view once Lovable finishes building: open the app at /loren?loren=1.
entries.bench: 10 Loren files on main · 3 additive tables live · 0 existing files modified · fully reversible (flag OFF)
